title: Photo annotation
idea: Photo annotation: Image inspection and named annotations share an explicit review list
audience: People who need to annotate within a mobile surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic craft layout through its annotate priority and explicit commitment contract: Persist edits as drafts until committed
navigation: Photo annotation keeps the current annotate context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Image inspection and named annotations share an explicit review list
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to annotate; visual observations need precise context
composition.priority: Persist edits as drafts until committed

imagery.role: Support the actual annotate context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Offer text list editing alongside direct image gestures
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the photo annotation structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no annotate content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Persist edits as drafts until committed
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized annotate content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Persist edits as drafts until committed
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active annotate context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
